profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ WHOOP
profile.summary:
I’m a backend software engineer at WHOOP, primarily working on Women’s Health. My work spans backend systems, health data, and increasingly AI/ML. I’ve worked on features like Menstrual Cycle Insights and Symptom Insights, and more recently have been building AI-powered systems for processing health data. I enjoy being involved from the early technical planning through implementation, especially when a project involves working across Product, Data Science, AI, and other engineering teams.

Over the past few years, I’ve also taken on more technical leadership such as leading engineers, scoping projects, and helping teams turn big ideas into something we can actually build. I’m still very hands-on and enjoy writing code, but I’ve found that I particularly like the problem-solving and planning side of engineering as well.

Outside of work, I’m a bit of a productivity geek and always looking for ways to improve how I work. I also love running, traveling, photography, gardening, baking, and spending time with my family. 

Always happy to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Backend engineer on WHOOP’s Women’s Health team, building systems that power personalized health experiences for members.
• Lead backend projects from technical planning and architecture through implementation and launch, working closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other engineering teams.
• Build backend systems across Women’s Health, including Menstrual Cycle Insights, Symptom Insights, and health data infrastructure.
• More recently, working on AI/ML-powered experiences, including AI-assisted health data processing, prediction model integrations, and user-facing AI agents.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Mercari is a Japanese e-commerce company which is the largest C2C online marketplace in Japan. It was founded in 2013 and was one of Japan’s first unicorns, raising $1.2B during its IPO in June 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Engineered and deployed a Python microservice enabling the CRM team to target diverse user segments with personalized marketing banners, supporting daily engagement of over 1.2 million users.
• Updated the logic to reduce the minimum listing price, resulting in a 50K increase in the number of new listings daily.
• Revised and consolidated Kubernetes manifests for several repositories, resulting in 30% improvement in development and deployment time.
• Developed and maintained monitoring systems using Grafana to enhance visibility into network and performance metrics, ensuring comprehensive oversight of service quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed integration and automated acceptance testing frameworks using Java and Cucumber, significantly boosting test coverage by 40%.
• Analyzed current performance metrics and tracked the improvement of regression suites over time.

positions.description: Skills: Load Testing · Python (Programming Language) · Software Deployment · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Agile Project Management

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:

• Helped students understand concepts and assisted them in targeting homework problems.

projects.title: "Get Lost. Be Found." - Travel Across America
projects.description:
Main photographer and designer.

Conducted crow funding campaign in Indiegogo and raised about $3,500. The group departed from Dallas, Texas, driving across 28 states, from West Coast to East Coast in three weeks. 

“Get Lost. Be Found.” is a collection of journals written in both Vietnamese and English, and photos depicting our life in the States through the scope of remarkable events, valuable experience, everyday life, and interesting people; mostly based on our trips around America. The ebook version of “Get Lost. Be Found.” will be published and uploaded for free as a gift of appreciation towards both good and bad things happening, people who have been here for us; and two countries which help us to find out our dreams and passions. Besides, we also publish the hard-copy version of “Get Lost. Be Found.” as a special gift for those who support us in this project.

The book will be published in April, 2014.

projects.title: BookSwap
projects.description:
• Built a full-stack web application for users to browse books and upload books for trade using Node.js and MongoDB.
• Designed database to efficiently store users, books, and comments; supported CRUD operations.

Project features:
• User authentication and permission for different operations
• Search function with AJAX

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Passport.js, RESTful.
